MK-CF-F-107: Combines guaranteed receipts and a draw coherently, but safe-to-spend wording is forbidden, simulation assumptions are incomplete, and guaranteed monthly average can hide timing risk.

formula_checks.name: theContributionRoom
formula_checks.why: Calls monthly contribution ×12 money used so far, hides overcontributions by capping used at the limit, counts only Roth IRA amounts for combined IRA room, and assumes self-only HSA cover.
formula_checks.should_be: Use confirmed year-to-date contributions per person across relevant accounts, show excesses, use coverage/eligibility months, and distinguish planned annual contributions from used.

formula_checks.name: ageAttainedInYear
formula_checks.why: Uses the calendar-year age required for catch-up thresholds and refuses an absent/unusable birth year; future birth years should be rejected at input.
formula_checks.rests_on: Written purpose and formula, on the stated valid input domain; ordinary arithmetic

formula_checks.name: monthsLeftInYear
formula_checks.why: Includes the current month explicitly: January12, December1.
formula_checks.rests_on: Written purpose and formula, on the stated valid input domain; ordinary arithmetic

formula_checks.name: perMonthToFill
formula_checks.why: Divides known room by explicitly inclusive remaining months and rounds only the displayed planning amount to $100; this rounded amount may leave residual room.
formula_checks.rests_on: Written purpose and formula, on the stated valid input domain; ordinary arithmetic

formula_checks.name: annual401kLimit
formula_checks.why: The supplied 2026 base and catch-up constants match IRS Notice 2025-67. Returns a statutory ceiling, not a determination of compensation/plan eligibility.
formula_checks.rests_on: Written purpose and formula, on the stated valid input domain; ordinary arithmetic

formula_checks.name: annualIraLimit
formula_checks.why: The 2026 base and catch-up constants match IRS Notice 2025-67; this is the combined statutory IRA ceiling, subject to compensation/eligibility rules.
formula_checks.rests_on: Written purpose and formula, on the stated valid input domain; ordinary arithmetic

formula_checks.name: annualHsaLimit
formula_checks.why: Base/catch-up constants are correct for a full eligible year, but current Medicare status alone cannot determine this year’s limit: eligible pre-enrollment months may still allow contributions.
formula_checks.should_be: Declare full-year eligibility as a precondition, or use month-by-month eligibility and permitted last-month-rule treatment.

formula_checks.name: k401Headroom
formula_checks.why: Caps reported used at the statutory limit, hiding an actual excess even though remaining room is correctly floored at zero.
formula_checks.should_be: Show actual contributed, limit, excess and remaining room separately; never erase an entered overcontribution.

formula_checks.name: rothVsTraditional
formula_checks.why: Implements a clearly conditional heuristic comparing current and expected future marginal bands; it is not an individualized optimal strategy.
formula_checks.rests_on: Written purpose and formula, on the stated valid input domain; ordinary arithmetic

formula_checks.name: rothConversionWindow
formula_checks.why: Age73 and Social Security claiming age are heuristic cutoff points, not a complete conversion-opportunity test. It can return false for a low-income retiree already claiming a small benefit.
formula_checks.should_be: Label a heuristic signal; use cohort-specific required-distribution rules and actual marginal tax capacity for advice.

formula_checks.name: futurePaycheck
formula_checks.why: Positive savings projections and simulation-supported draws cannot be independently computed without the projection’s public equations and timing conventions.
formula_checks.should_be: Supply mathematical simulation/projection contract; meantime test refusals, composition and labeled assumptions.

formula_checks.name: guaranteedRows
formula_checks.why: Dated payment placement is correct, but the inflation flags captured by guaranteedOutsideStreams are not reflected in next-year payments in the described rolling grid.
formula_checks.should_be: State whether the 12-month grid holds nominal flat amounts or adjusts inflation-linked payments, with source-year assumptions.

formula_checks.name: solveSafeDraw
formula_checks.why: Twelve bisections inside an unverified initial upper bound do not establish the largest feasible draw. An all-feasible bracket can cap the answer too low; a chanceFloor argument is not reflected in the fixed80 wording.
formula_checks.should_be: Expand until an infeasible upper bound is proven, keep feasible/infeasible invariants, use the requested floor, declare tolerance and validate the downward-rounded draw.
formula_checks.rests_on: Package public signature; ordinary bounded-search correctness

formula_checks.name: buildPaycheckYear
formula_checks.why: Combines guaranteed receipts and a draw coherently, but safe-to-spend wording is forbidden, simulation assumptions are incomplete, and guaranteed monthly average can hide timing risk.
formula_checks.should_be: Use approved affordability wording, disclose projection assumptions and retain bill/guaranteed timing; never include withdrawals as outside income.

rules_held.decision_in_force: NOT A DECISION OF HIS — the lead's decision of 2026-10-24 under his rulings DEC-1923 and DEC-3523 (tenets 1 and 4), made without asking him, as his order of 2026-09-30 says. One rule for a debt in a month, in two new shared functions, MK-CF-F-235 paysInMonth and MK-CF-F-236 paymentInMonth: from its first payment to its payoff, and a balance due in full once, in its month, at its balance. A $7,200 take-home, a $3,400 budget, the $2,400 mortgage, a $250 car loan whose first payment is Oct 28, a $300 loan paid off in August and a $1,000 tax bill due in full Sep 20: September's planned surplus read +$850, the car loan and the paid-off loan counted and the tax bill left out; it reads +$400 = 7,200 − 3,400 − 2,400 − 1,000, what the Bill calendar's September holds. October's card is unchanged, $1,150. ACTUAL no longer lists the car loan as due the 28th at $0; MONTHLY RECURRING EXPENSES reads $2,400 (it read $2,650); the tax bill is on the BIG-TICKET RADAR at $1,000; Home's due-soon reminder no longer fires for a loan not yet started. MK-CF-M-047, 048 and 049 now say they print on a later month's plan card, from the grid ($7,200 / $6,050 / $1,150), and the retired surplus line and the paycheck card's SURPLUS have their own number, MK-CF-M-078 (it printed under MK-CF-M-049). To reverse: count every debt's payment in this month again, whatever its dates. One word from him reverses it.
